name: DOT Traffic Speeds
description:
This dataset contains traffic speed and travel time readings for road links in New York City, collected by the Department of Transportation. Each row represents one observation for a specific road segment, identified by a link ID and name, and includes the measured speed, estimated travel time, a status code, and the timestamp of the reading. Geographic context is provided through the borough, the owning agency (such as NYC DOT, MTA Bridges & Tunnels, or the Port Authority), and an encoded polyline that traces the segment's path. The sample covers 125 distinct links across all five boroughs, with Queens, Staten Island, Manhattan, and the Bronx appearing most often.

The data can be used to monitor current traffic conditions, analyze congestion patterns, and compare performance across boroughs or specific corridors. Because each record includes a timestamp, it supports time-series analysis of how speeds and travel times change throughout the day.
